args.notes: Official Epic Games requisition R27423 and embedded Apply form verified live on 2026-09-08. On-site in Novi Sad; flexible 2027 start; requires legal authorization in Serbia, 40 hours/week, education details, and links to directly contributed projects. Strong stack and local-work-authorization fit. Main risk: Epic's general Early Careers page focuses on candidates with under 1 year of formal work experience and active students or graduates within 1 year, while the exact role itself only asks for familiarity through coursework, projects, or prior experience.
